datasets.name: SessionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  SID,
  Serial#,
  AudSID,
  user#,
  UserName,
  Status,
  OSUser,
  Process,
  Machine,
  Terminal,
  Program,
  Logon_Time,
  decode(UserEnv('SESSIONID'), AudSID, 1, 0) as IsCurrentUser
from sys.v_$session
where
  (Type = 'USER')
  and (UserName is not null)
  and (Program = (
    select program 
      from sys.v_$session 
    where AudSID = UserEnv('SESSIONID')
    )
  )
  and (Status <> 'KILLED')
